---
name: project-audit
description: Audit repository state and evidence without changing application code.
---

Read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/coordination/PROJECT_STATUS.md`, `CURRENT_TASKS.md`, and `AGENT_HANDOFF.md` first. Inspect Git status/branch and relevant source/docs before reaching conclusions. Report verified architecture, production/research boundaries, current task/PR ownership, risks, stale or conflicting documentation, and exact evidence paths. Separate facts, proposals, and unknowns. Do not edit files unless separately assigned; do not infer security guarantees or claim tests were run without evidence.
